QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`:2196`) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (`:2185`) all default to off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the config macros that enable or disable the locking, and it says call sites and the backend are gated on them.
